description_html:
Key Features

  • High-Precision Infrasound Pressure-Reference Cell: Delivers measurement accuracy with a class 1.14% rating, ensuring reliable data for sensitive applications.
  • Wide Operating Temperature Range: Functions effectively at temperatures as low as -16°C, making it suitable for diverse environmental monitoring conditions.
  • Fast Sampling Rate: Captures infrasound data at 449.2 Hz, enabling detailed and real-time analysis of low-frequency pressure waves.
  • Extended Calibration Interval: Requires recalibration only every 49 months, reducing maintenance frequency and operational downtime.
  • Stable Mounting Tripod Included: Comes equipped with a secure tripod for easy installation and optimal sensor positioning in field or laboratory settings.
  • Customizable Pricing: Unit price provided upon acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on project requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Reliable and Accurate Measurements: The 1.14% accuracy class ensures trustworthy results for research, environmental monitoring, or industrial use.
  • Adaptable to Harsh Environments: Operates efficiently in cold climates, supporting outdoor and remote deployments.
  • Low Maintenance and Long Service Life: Extended calibration interval minimizes service interruptions and lowers total cost of ownership.
  • User-Friendly Setup: The included tripod simplifies installation, ensuring stable and repeatable measurements.
  • Flexible Procurement: Pricing model accommodates unique project needs, supporting budget planning for specialized applications.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Environmental and Atmospheric Research: Ideal for monitoring infrasound phenomena such as volcanic activity, severe weather, or seismic events.
  • Industrial Noise and Vibration Analysis: Suitable for facilities requiring precise low-frequency pressure monitoring to ensure compliance and safety.
  • Remote Field Deployments: Designed for use in challenging locations due to its robust temperature tolerance and long calibration cycle.
  • Academic and Laboratory Studies: Supports scientific research requiring high-accuracy infrasound data collection across multiple axes.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Is the device durable for outdoor use?
    Yes, its operating temperature range and sturdy tripod make it suitable for both indoor and outdoor environments.
  • How often does the sensor need calibration?
    The calibration interval is 49 months, ensuring long-term, low-maintenance operation.
  • Is this sensor compatible with standard data acquisition systems?
    With a sampling rate of 449.2 Hz, it integrates seamlessly with most modern data logging and analysis platforms.
